instruction.name: vsrlrn.w.d
instruction.description: Logical right shift with rounding each unsigned 64-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 64, write the lower 32 bits of the shifted result into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
